Account.SteamCred.Title: Steam credentials for installs
Account.SteamCred.Hint: Phaket signs in to Steam once so it can download games. The account name and password go to your system's native secret store (GNOME Keyring/KWallet on Linux, DPAPI on Windows). Phaket never writes the password to settings, never uploads it and never logs it — during an install it is passed only to the standard input of the DepotDownloader tool.

Help.Secrets: Account tokens and install credentials go to the native system secret store: GNOME Keyring (libsecret) or KWallet on Linux, DPAPI on Windows. Phaket never writes passwords to the settings file, and never sends them to the cloud or to logs.
Help.SecretsMigration: Entries previously stored in .bin files can be moved into the system store in one click from Settings. Migration backs up the old file and leaves it untouched if anything fails.
Help.SecretsFallback: When no system wallet is available you can use the emergency file store. It encrypts data with a password (PBKDF2 + AES-GCM); the password is required at every unlock and lasts for the current session only.
Help.SecretsDelete: You can permanently delete every secret from Settings after confirming. Deleted tokens have to be entered again at the next sign-in.
Help.SteamKey: Phaket does not need a Steam Web API key. It reads the game library locally from the installed Steam files (libraryfolders.vdf, ACF manifests), so it works without a network connection and without sharing data with Valve.
Help.Tools: Phaket downloads helper tools automatically from official GitHub Releases and verifies every file with a SHA-256 checksum before running it. If the checksum does not match, the tool is not started.
Help.ToolsLegendary: Legendary (Epic Games) — GNU GPL v3: https://github.com/legendary-gl/legendary
Help.Catalog: The mod catalog and the build lists require a catalog server. The Phaket server is not published yet, so the "catalog offline" view is a normal state; installed mods and games work without it.
Help.CatalogEndpoint: Set the catalog server address in Settings (default https://stage.phaket.app — the public stage test environment over TLS; on the LAN the same name resolves via split-DNS). When the connection is back, select "Refresh" to download the data.
Shell.SelectGameMessage: Pick a game in the sidebar, or add one in the Library, to see modpacks, profiles and compatibility.
